text:
maria (support): Hey team, ACME mobile flagged duplicate token billing on today's invoice. They ran ~1k requests, but ledger shows ~2k tokens billed. Says this started after an auth refresh rollout earlier today. root_req=0a1b2c
liam (billing): Can you drop the gateway logs and any ledger rows? we'll need correlation ids and customer id to consider refund.
maria (support): Pasting truncated gateway log (customer-supplied):
```
2026-03-16T14:02:11Z gateway INFO req=0a1b2c user=acme client_ip=3.8.12.5 idempotency-key=ikey-7a token_count=512 status=202
2026-03-16T14:02:12Z gateway INFO req=0a1b2c user=acme client_ip=3.8.12.5 idempotency-key=ikey-8b token_count=512 status=202
```
They have two accepted requests with same req id but different idempotency keys. Customer says their SDK retried after a 401 from auth refresh.
jonah (client-sdk): That matches a bug we saw in the mobile refresh path: when we refresh credentials we currently rebuild the outgoing request and regenerate a fresh idempotency key instead of reusing the one attached to the original attempt. If the retry reaches the gateway before the original ACK gets reconciled, gateway treats as a new request.
replay-bot: automated-note: incoming retry detection missed - no x-replay-id header present.
sophie (sre): Is the gateway dedupe only based on idempotency-key? if so missing / changed key will cause double execution. Any chance the client is also re-sending while the original is still in-flight?
jonah (client-sdk): Repro steps I used locally: 1) send request with ikey-A, auth token about to expire; 2) simulate auth refresh mid-request -> SDK issues retry with ikey-B; 3) original request had high tail latency so both attempts hit the runtime. I can repro reliably with a 50ms auth refresh latency and 200ms server tail.
priya (platform): We should consider a short-term gateway mitigation: if we see two requests with same root_req id or identical client request fingerprint within 2s and different idempotency keys, treat as potential replay and route to dedupe queue. But need to avoid blocking legitimate concurrent requests.
liam (billing): For customer impact: ledger shows two separate token_write entries at 14:02:11 and 14:02:12 for acme-org. I'll prepare a manual refund for the duplicated tokens once eng confirms duplicate execution. Need the request bodies / model + token counts.
maria (support): Customer attached model name and approximate prompt lengths. I'll forward. They asked for an immediate credit and a mitigation so this doesn't recur.
jonah (client-sdk): I can push a hotfix to the mobile SDK to persist the outgoing idempotency-key across an auth refresh (store per-request in a transient context). That reduces risk on the client side. Patch will be very small and I can cut a new patch today.
sophie (sre): Longer term we should also make gateway de-dup idempotent by falling back to a weak fingerprint if idempotency-key is missing or changed but the client_request_id header matches. e.g., hash(user, route, client_req_id, recent_payload_digest). Keep window small (5s).
priya (platform): I'll prototype an ingress rule to tag likely duplicates and return a 200 with the original operation id to clients within the window (non-breaking). Will need a short maintenance window to ship safely.
liam (billing): Action items for me: 1) hold a provisional credit for acme; 2) run reconciliation job to identify other orgs affected by auth-refresh window (query ledger for duplicate token writes within 2s per org); 3) finalize refunds after eng confirms root cause.
maria (support): Customer is ok with provisional credit, wants a postmortem and timeline. I'll coordinate comms once we have reconciliation numbers.
jonah (client-sdk): I'll open PR and tag @maria for SDK patch notes. Also will add an integration test that simulates mid-request auth refresh + retry to prevent regressions.
sophie (sre): Also add a short-lived alert to detect spike of near-duplicate token writes (same org, same route) so we catch regressions quickly.
priya (platform): Rolling a small gate for dedupe tagging to canary tonight. Will update this thread with the rollout id.
liam (billing): I'll attach the provisional credit transaction id here when posted.
maria (support): Thanks all — keeping customer updated. :thumbsup:
jonah (client-sdk): quick note: sample code to preserve idempotency header across refresh: ```js // pseudo
const req = buildRequest(); req.headers['Idempotency-Key'] = ctx.requestKey || uuid(); try { await send(req); } catch (e) { if (e.status===401) { await refreshAuth(); // DO NOT reset ctx.requestKey send(req); } } ```
liam (billing): filing internal billing ticket BLG-2026 to track refunds.
replay-bot: monitor-scan scheduled to run at +1h for similar patterns.
priya (platform): rollout id: canary-dup-detect-20260316-7. will post metrics after 30m.
